summary.case_id: Case 11: Shoulder closure on divided highway

taper.formula_choice: Speed 65 mph >= 45 mph threshold -> using L = W x S
taper.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.08, Table 6B-4 (taper length L). Shoulder closures use L/3 per Sec 6B.08 (Table 6B-3).
taper.cdot_reference: CDOT S-630-1 Case 11 (right-shoulder closure on divided highway)

buffer.lookup_text: MUTCD Table 6B-2: 645 ft. CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 14 posts a 570 ft minimum at 65 mph, but only as part of the Case 26 mandatory speed step-down (65 → 60 mph); this plan has no qualifying reduction, so the federal posted-speed value governs (Sheet 7 Case 11: buffer VARIES per General Note 24).
buffer.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.06, Table 6B-2 (stopping sight distance). CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 7 Case 11 (buffer VARIES per General Note 24).

spacing.in_taper_text: 65 mph -> 65 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals speed in feet)
spacing.on_tangent_text: 65 mph -> 130 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals 2x speed in feet)
spacing.taper_count_text: L/3 = 217 ft / 65 ft max spacing -> 5 drums at 54.2 ft intervals
spacing.tangent_count_text: 1000 ft / 130 ft max spacing -> 9 cones at 125.0 ft intervals
spacing.downstream_count_text: Downstream taper: 50 ft at ~25 ft spacing -> 2 cones (MUTCD Sec 6B.08: 50-100 ft downstream taper); 9 tangent + 2 downstream = 11 cones total

advance.road_type_text: Speed 65 mph, road_type = 'rural' -> Table 6B-1 category: rural

checks.label: Signs on both sides of divided highway
checks.detail: Required: True. Signs placed: 7 left, 11 right.

checks.label: G20-5P Work Zone signs every 2,640 ft
Speed reduction <= 15 mph per sign installation
checks.detail: No work-zone speed reduction. Posted speed 65 mph applies throughout the zone.
